context.transcript:
Hello.
Are you a volunteer at this event?
Yes, I am.
Are you enjoying the car show?
Yes. l've never seen so many antique cars in one place.
But I'm starting to get hungry.
Where are the food vendors set up?
Just on the other side of the main hall.
I recommend Rosa's.
Their food is delicious.
Rosa's?
Okay.
I'll check it out.
Just be warned that you may have to stand in line.
It's the most popular booth every year.
